turn_prompts: Generate an independent reference solution plan and implementation artifact for the approved task. Keep it separate from solver instructions and use only local deterministic behavior. When invoking the stage-private harbor_submit_stage_output dynamic tool, set the sole artifact content_base64 to the standard base64 encoding of the final executable solution/solve.sh bytes themselves. The decoded payload must be a raw shell script beginning with a shebang, not a JSON object, format/version envelope, solve_script or content field, artifact-name field, Markdown code fence, or explanatory wrapper. Do not finish with prose alone; only an accepted tool submission is a stage result.
